_comment: Metadata for the feature demo gallery. id matches the test title in demos.spec.ts (and the raw/demos-<id>-chromium/ folder). caption is the SINGLE SOURCE for the on-screen banner: demos.spec.ts burns it into the recording and build-gallery.mjs prints it above the clip, so the two can never drift. area groups the gallery into collapsible sections. build-gallery.mjs converts each recorded video to a small H.264 MP4 and renders test/demos/gallery/index.html.

demos.title: Navigate tuples
demos.caption: ↑ / ↓  — move between tuples (airplane → baboon → peppers → back to baboon)
demos.description: Move between image tuples; the carousel highlight and main image follow. The clip steps down twice, then back up once to show both directions.

demos.title: Switch modality
demos.caption: ← / →  — switch modality (original ⇄ desaturated ⇄ …), zoom/pan stay locked
demos.description: Flip between modalities (e.g. original vs desaturated) for the current tuple; the active pill updates.

demos.title: Click a modality pill
demos.caption: Click a colored modality pill to jump to it
demos.description: Click a colored modality pill to jump straight to that modality.

demos.title: Zoom
demos.caption: Scroll to zoom in — Esc resets to fit
demos.description: Scroll to zoom into the image; press Esc to reset to fit.

demos.title: Pan
demos.caption: Zoom in, then drag to pan around the image
demos.description: When zoomed in, drag to move around the image.

demos.title: Crop
demos.caption: Press C, drag a rectangle, Enter — crops every modality at once
demos.description: Enter crop mode, draw a rectangle, and confirm to crop all modalities at once.

demos.title: Vote a winner
demos.caption: Enter — mark the current modality as the winner (saved to results.txt)
demos.description: Mark the current modality as the winner for this tuple; saved to results.txt.

demos.title: Reorder modalities
demos.caption: [ / ]  — reorder the modality pills
demos.description: Reorder the modality pills to change comparison order (and PPTX export order).

demos.title: Keyboard help
demos.caption: Click “?” for the keyboard-shortcut reference — Esc closes it
demos.description: Open the keyboard-shortcut reference; Esc closes it.

demos.title: Collapse tools panel
demos.caption: Collapse / expand the floating Tools panel
demos.description: Collapse or expand the floating Tools/navigator panel.
